title: Demo: Velkommen
text:
<$list filter="[{$:/language}else[$:/languages/en-GB]prefix[$:/languages/da]]" variable="locale">
! Standard-TiddlyWiki med Forge Plugin Library

Dette er en almindelig TiddlyWiki med Forge Plugin Library tilføjet.

Opret dine egne tiddlere med plusknappen, og gem med TiddlyWikis Gem-knap.

Du kan installere flere plugins fra //Forge Plugin Library// via [[Kontrolpanel|$:/ControlPanel]] → Plugins → Get more plugins. Det kræver internet at hente plugins. F-knappen fører tilbage til Forge.
</$list>
<$list filter="[{$:/language}else[$:/languages/en-GB]!prefix[$:/languages/da]]" variable="locale">
! Standard TiddlyWiki with Forge Plugin Library

This is a standard TiddlyWiki with Forge Plugin Library added.

Use the plus button to create your own tiddlers, and save with TiddlyWiki’s Save button.

Install more plugins from //Forge Plugin Library// via the [[Control Panel|$:/ControlPanel]] → Plugins → Get more plugins. Downloading plugins requires internet access. The F button takes you back to Forge.
</$list>
caption: TiddlyWiki + Forge Plugin Library
